thread:
matt_sales: ACME's vendor risk team wants a 48-hour "fast advisory" and a redacted "forensics sample" during the POC. they asked whether hosted vs VPC changes what we can promise. call in 90m. any sharp answers? :alarm_clock:

priya_security: tl;dr: hosted customers get contractual notification windows in the MA (typically 72h for incidents). for POCs we can offer a non-binding 48h advisory (summary + redacted artifacts) but only under NDA and with scope limits. Dedicated/VPC makes stronger guarantees feasible but requires SLA/legal tweaks.

li_eng: tech side: for hosted we can produce an automated artifact that includes request_id, model_version, timestamps, token_counts, response_code, latency, and sanitized stack traces. we intentionally exclude raw user content unless there's a legal requirement. retention defaults: 30 days for hosted, 90+ for Dedicated.

emma_cs: ACME said redaction is fine, they want to see a sample bundle within 48h of a confirmed issue to satisfy their risk team signoff. they said this is a POC gating item.

priya_security: propose a short POC play: 1) execute a one-way NDA or limited-forensics NDA; 2) produce a Preliminary Advisory within 48h of Vendor confirmation of an incident affecting the POC environment; 3) deliver a Redacted Forensic Bundle (list format) via secure share; 4) follow the contract's formal notice timeline (e.g., 72h) for legal notification.

matt_sales: can you draft a 2-line clause for ACME legal I can drop into the SOW?

priya_security: draft below (POC-specific):

"Preliminary Advisory for POC. For the limited-duration proof-of-concept (POC), Vendor will use commercially reasonable efforts to issue a Preliminary Advisory within forty-eight (48) hours after Vendor's confirmation that a security event materially affecting Customer's POC environment has occurred. The Preliminary Advisory will include a high-level timeline, impacted components, and a Redacted Forensic Bundle containing non-content identifiers (request_id, request_hash, timestamps), model identifiers, token usage, and sanitized error traces. Full customer content will not be shared absent a separate forensics agreement or legal requirement. Formal breach notification obligations in the Master Agreement remain in effect and will follow the contract's notice provisions."

li_eng: implementation note: we can script the bundle export and SFTP it. redaction approach: deterministic hashing for request ids, regex-based PII removal for configured fields, and drop payload bodies by default. ops ETA: 1 engineer-day to build script + test; need security sign-off on fields to redact.

emma_cs: what about SIEM/partner integration? ACME mentioned sending artifacts into their Splunk instance during the POC.
